verdicts.rewritten_summary: National-framework source (applies country-wide; no provincial breakdown): HRW news release, Oct 29, 2025, reports the leaked omnibus draft ("11th Judicial Package") that would amend the Turkish penal code to criminalise conduct deemed "contrary to biological sex and general morality" (up to three years in prison) and participation in same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies (up to four years), and would raise the minimum age for gender-affirming care including surgery from 18 to 25 behind mandatory permanent infertility and repeated evaluations at government-approved hospitals; healthcare professionals performing such interventions would face fines and up to seven years in prison and patients up to three years, with possible pretrial detention. Fifteen LGBT groups and the Turkish Medical Association opposed the draft; HRW warns it would force treatment underground and leave LGBT people in constant fear of arrest.
